title: Apply the dimension-4 transfer to X102's 52-edge state
body:
## Summary
- The dimension-3 transfer leaves X102 on 52 edges. Dimension 4 grants X102 no new read.
- The same interval bounds, tested at dimension 4, add 313 edges from 98 departure slots on 74 channels. The resulting count is 365.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The dimension-5 relation is not built. The receipt includes a SHA-256 digest of the 365 reached edge indices.
